_about: Where the scout looks (backlog B1), confirmed 14 October 2026: LinkedIn and hackajob alert emails, read through Proton Mail Bridge; Google's and Microsoft's own careers alerts added 16 October 2026 (B12). LinkedIn and hackajob already do the first cut with the owner's own saved searches; the scout refines what they send. 'senders' are IMAP FROM searches, which match any part of the sender's address.

replies._about: Sprint 6a (I1): replies to applications. Searched read-only, from the hiring systems above and the companies and recruiters on data\watchlist.json. 'firstLookDays' is how far back the first run looks (the owner, 17 Oct 2026: 60 days); every move from that first look is a suggestion.

_aboutReplySenders: Hiring systems' mail domains (I1). Their application emails come from these; their marketing domains (greenhouse.io, lever.co) are left out on purpose, so newsletters are not read as replies. LinkedIn is special: only its application-update emails count, matched by subject.
